correctness.rationale: The total variation is max over 2^{n−1} sign-word linear scores. For z=e^theta>1, comparison of endpoint and sign-transition contributions proves alternating signs uniquely maximize the exponential score for odd n or with both signs for even n. Their cumulant log mgfs are the exact displayed Z_n formula, strictly convex with support maximum 2. Relative-entropy variational equality gives the unique corresponding tilted probability comb(s). Competing sign words have a strict mgf gap at theta_t, hence exponentially negligible tails by Chernoff. For winning scores, maximal lattice spans are 3 and offset −N for n=3, and span 1 offset −2N for n>=4; exponential change of measure plus the lattice local CLT gives h exp(−theta delta)/[(1−e^{−h theta})sqrt(2π Nv)] and the even/odd multiplicity K_n. Endpoint D=2N is exactly the interior path independent-support condition. Independently enumerated all sign words for n=3..11 at rational z=2 and recovered claimed maximizing patterns. Assumption: n,t fixed as N grows.
